faq.question: Baal girne ka sabse bada karan kya hai?
faq.answer: Hair fall ke main karano mein stress, nutritional deficiency (vitamin D, iron, protein kikami), hormonal imbalance, genetics, aur scalp infections shamil hain.

faq.question: Kya hair fall ko permanently rok sakte hain?
faq.answer: Haan, agar root cause ko identify karke sahi treatment aur lifestyle changes apnaye jayen to hair fall ko control aur reduce kiya ja sakta hai.

faq.question: Hair fall rokne ke liye sabse best oil kaun sa hai?
faq.answer: Coconut oil, castor oil, aur almond oil hair fall control ke liye best hain. Regular massage se blood circulation badhta hai.

faq.question: Kitne din mein hair fall control ho jata hai?
faq.answer: Natural remedies se 4-6 weeks mein improvement dikhna shuru hota hai. Complete results ke liye 3-6 months ka consistent treatment zaroori hai.
